title: Aptamer Design by Reinforcement Learning-Based Fine-Tuning of Generative Language Models
venue: US Patent Application US 2025/0111890 A1 · X Development LLC
authors: Jon Deaton, Ryan Poplin, Ray Nagatani, Michelle Wynn, Anand Pai, Joshua D'Arcy
executive_summary: A closed-loop aptamer development system that fine-tunes a reward model and a decoder model — using in vitro experimental data and reinforcement learning — to iteratively generate novel aptamer sequences optimized against a molecular target.
